description: This file defines the 'WorkShiftController' class, which is responsible for handling the 'work-shift-list' component in the orangehrm Admin plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up a component for rendering work shift lists in the HRM system.

classes.name: WorkShiftController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling work shift management view in the admin plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and overrides the preRender method to set up the work shift list component.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Initializes a new Vue component with the identifier 'work-shift-list' and assigns it to be rendered, as part of the pre-render process.
